review_candidates.title: Mine Maintenance Superintendent
review_candidates.description: Mine Maintenance Superintendent Position Specifications Position: Mine Maintenance Superintendent Location: Oko West Project, Guyana The Mine Maintenance Superintendent will lead all maintenance activities for the mining fleet at the Oko West Project in Guyana, ensuring safe execution while maximising equipment availability, reliability and cost effectiveness in support of production targets. Reporting to the Mine Manager, the role leads the maintenance team — general foremen, engineers, supervisors, planners and technicians — and coordinates closely with Mine Operations, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Engineering, OEMs and contractors to ensure effective maintenance planning, execution, parts availability and continuous improvement. This is a rotation-based role in a remote mining environment, requiring strong field presence and effective coordination of maintenance activities across operating shifts. The Company In 2020, G Mining Ventures (GMIN) was created to acquire direct ownership of projects and capitalise on the value uplift that successful mine development offers. In July 2024, GMIN acquired the Oko West Project, a new gold discovery in northwest Guyana located approximately 95 km west of Georgetown, which the Company is now developing into an operating mine. Our client has selected Globe 24-7 Inc. as its strategic recruitment partner to successfully fill the above-mentioned position and to add value to the hiring strategy with market knowledge, trends and a proven track record in conducting similar searches. Main Responsibilities Lead all planned, preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance activities for the mining fleet, including shovels, excavators, haul trucks, drills, dozers, graders, loaders and support equipment. Maximise fleet availability and reliability by monitoring equipment condition, breakdowns, recurring failures, maintenance backlog, component life and maintenance KPIs, implementing timely corrective actions. Ensure effective maintenance planning and scheduling, covering preventive maintenance, major repairs, component replacements, shutdowns, work orders, manpower, tooling and resources. Lead maintenance general foremen, supervisors, planners, technicians and contractors, ensuring adequate staffing, competency development, performance management, accountability and effective shift handovers. Ensure effective use of the Maintenance Management System, maintaining accurate equipment history, work orders, maintenance costs, parts consumption and performance data to support decision-making and continuous improvement. Coordinate with Supply Chain, Warehouse, OEMs and suppliers to ensure availability of critical spare parts, consumables, major components, technical support and warranty follow-up. Develop and control maintenance budgets, forecasts and costs, identifying opportunities to improve equipment lifecycle performance and reduce downtime and maintenance costs. Provide visible safety leadership and ensure all maintenance activities comply with Company HSE standards, including isolation, lockout, lifting, stored energy, pressure systems and other maintenance-related critical risks. Position Requirements As the successful candidate, it is essential that you possess the following skills, experience and competencies: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance or a related technical field preferred; equivalent technical qualifications combined with significant relevant experience may be considered. Minimum 10 to 15 years of progressive heavy equipment maintenance experience, including at least five years in a senior supervisory or superintendent role. Strong experience managing and maintaining large mining fleets and leading multidisciplinary maintenance teams. Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, major component management and maintenance planning. Strong understanding of maintenance KPIs, including equipment availability, MTBF, MTTR, schedule compliance, backlog and maintenance costs. Proven experience with a Maintenance Management System and maintenance data management; SAP PM or a similar system is an asset. Strong knowledge of maintenance budgeting, cost control, spare parts management and coordination with OEMs and suppliers. Strong leadership, communication, organisational, analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a remote and demanding mining environment. In addition, the following behavioural competencies are essential to succeed in the role: Strong safety leadership and field presence. High level of accountability, ownership and operational discipline. Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Effective team leadership, coaching and development. Strong collaboration with Operations and support departments. Continuous improvement and equipment reliability mindset. Compensation Our client will provide a market-related remuneration package, including an annual performance bonus and participation in the Company's group medical and life insurance plan for the employee and dependents. The position is residential at site on a rotational roster of 23 days on and 19 days off. For international candidates, the Company provides international and in-country travel, accommodation and meals while in Guyana, together with support throughout the required immigration process. Contact Us To apply for this position, please send a copy of your resume in Word format.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Anglo American Australia operates five steelmaking coal mines in Queensland’s Bowen Basin, and have additional joint venture interests in manganese, as well as copper exploration projects under way in North West Queensland. Steelmaking coal is an essential ingredient in blast-furnace steel manufacture, producing steel used for critical building and infrastructure around the world. Job Description We are seeking an experienced Longwall Mechanical Production Fitter to join our underground production team at Moranbah North Mine. This is a hands on role in maintaining and supporting critical longwall equipment to keep the operation running safely, reliably, and efficiently. You will work alongside production, electrical, and maintenance personnel to identify mechanical issues, complete planned maintenance, and respond to equipment breakdowns. About The Role Reporting to the Longwall Mechanical Supervisor, your responsibilities will include: Performing planned, preventative and breakdown maintenance on longwall equipment Inspecting, maintaining and repairing shearers, AFCs, BSLs and powered roof supports Maintaining and fault-finding hydraulic and mechanical systems Diagnosing equipment faults and completing practical repairs to minimise production delays Supporting longwall production and equipment availability Completing equipment inspections and identifying emerging defects Assisting with component changeouts, installations and longwall moves when required Following isolation, stored-energy and underground risk-control requirements Completing work orders and maintenance records accurately Working closely with operators, electricians and other trades Maintaining high standards of housekeeping and equipment care Contributing to a positive, respectful and safety focused crew The longwall is the mine’s primary production area, with equipment availability, operating capability and effective management of delays directly affecting coal production Qualifications About you To be successful in this role, you will ideally have: Australian recognised Mechanical Trade Qualification Experience working in an underground coal mine Previous longwall mechanical maintenance experience Experience with shearers, AFCs, BSLs, roof supports and hydraulic systems Strong mechanical fault-finding and troubleshooting skills Experience completing planned and breakdown maintenance A sound understanding of isolation and stored-energy controls Strong safety awareness and hazard-identification skills The ability to work effectively within a production-focused team Clear communication and a practical approach to problem-solving Current underground competencies and qualifications required for the position A current Australian driver’s licence Longwall equipment includes the shearer, AFC and powered roof supports, with mechanical work involving commissioning, installation, maintenance and equipment inspections. If you are an experienced underground Mechanical Fitter who enjoys working on production equipment, solving mechanical problems and being part of a high-performing longwall crew, we would like to hear from you. Additional Information What we offer Permanent employment opportunity 7 on 7 off day night roster Competitive remuneration and site benefits Camp accommodation and meals Ongoing technical training and development Exposure to specialised underground longwall equipment A supportive and experienced production team Career development within underground mining operations Who We Are We aim to lead the industry by pursuing ever safer and more responsible ways of working, demonstrating integrity, and showing care and respect for people and the planet. That means we are constantly seeking new opportunities to mine and process our products sustainably, using less water, less energy and more precise extraction technologies. Anglo American is a leading global mining company focused on the responsible production of copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients – future-enabling products that are essential for decarbonising the global economy, improving living standards, and food security. Our extraordinary teams work safely and collaboratively to unlock enduring value from precious natural resources for our shareholders, for the benefit of the communities and countries in which we operate, and for society as a whole. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives. Background checks Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening which may include a criminal check and validation of qualifications. Inclusion and Diversity Anglo American is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfil their potential. How We Are Committed To Your Safety Nothing is more important to us than ensuring you return home safely after a day’s work. To make that happen, we have the most rigorous safety standards in the industry. Not only that, we’re also continually investing in new technologies – from drones to data analytics – that are helping to make mining safer. How To Apply To apply for this role, please complete our online application form. You will have the opportunity to upload your CV and other relevant documentation as part of this process. REF81188J CLOSING DATE 13 September 2026 Please note, screening and interviews may take place prior to closing date applications may also close before this date. Recruitment Agencies Anglo American Australia does not accept unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies.

review_candidates.title: Global Graduate Program - Commerce
review_candidates.description: Global Graduate Program Explore our world, Explore your Future Commerce – the Netherlands Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey and discover the world of HEINEKEN? Our Global Graduate Program is designed to fast-track your career, equipping you with the skills, experiences, and opportunities to grow into a future leader at one of the world's most renowned brands. About the program: As part of this three-year journey, you will complete three rotations, each lasting six months, within your chosen area in the Netherlands: Commerce or Finance. After the rotations, you will have the opportunity to spend the next 18-months working in a role within your home operating company in the Netherlands. Rotation 1: Start your journey within HEINEKEN in the Netherlands (country of application). Here, you will build a strong foundation in your chosen function while gaining a deeper understanding of our operations, strategy, and culture. Rotation 2: Continue in the Netherlands with a cross-functional assignment, widening your perspective and understanding of different business areas and how they interconnect. Rotation 3: Broaden your horizons with an international assignment, enhancing your global mindset and cultural adaptability. Landing Role: Now you have got all the tools, it is time for you to apply what you have learnt in a starting position within the Netherlands. Every day will bring a chance to continue with your growth and development. A handful of (program) highlights: A great graduate community: Join a vibrant network of graduates from around the world, sharing experiences and learning together. Support and mentorship: Learn from former graduates and senior leaders who will guide and support you on your path. Extensive learning journey: Engage in a thorough learning and development program designed to help you become your best self. A vast range of assignments: Experience a variety of assignments that will challenge and inspire you, giving you a broader understanding of our business. About Our Commercial Track The Commercial track is for recent graduates eager to make an impact in our dynamic commercial environment. Throughout the program, you will gain hands-on experience across various domains, from sales and marketing to digital innovation. Work on impactful projects that not only strengthen customer relationships but also drive significant brand growth. Assignments could include Brand Management for a new product launch or optimizing our E-commerce strategy. Expect real responsibility, cross-functional collaboration, and dedicated coaching and training to support your development. Your assignments will be primarily based at our Leiden office. Who are we searching for: Ambitious individuals: Passionate about building a meaningful career in one of our key functions. Open and adventurous: Ready to embrace new challenges and explore diverse experiences. Leadership potential: Prepared to take initiative, lead projects, and drive change. What you will learn: The HEINEKEN Way: Gain an exclusive insight into our strategic direction and contribute to its execution. Project leadership: Take the lead on projects that drive our business forward. Stakeholder & change management: Develop the skills needed to manage stakeholders and lead effective and meaningful change. Criteria & Conditions: Education: A finished Master’s degree at the start of the program. Your study background and field of study don’t matter! Work experience: No specific previous work experience is required! But we are looking specifically for new graduates. That’s a maximum of 1-year post-graduation (graduation date between January 2026 and March 2027). Languages: Being comfortable with the Dutch and English language is essential. Work Rights: The legal work rights to work in the Netherlands (no visa sponsorship). Travel Flexibility: Global exploration can’t happen from home! We require all Graduates to be fully globally mobile. The journey of a lifetime starts with just one step. Are you ready to Explore the world of HEINEKEN? Apply now! How to apply & the selection process: Application submission: Upload your CV and cover letter through our application portal. The application period is from August 31st until September 20th. Online assessments: Take the online assessment from September 21st until September 27th. The assessment will be based on situational behaviour scenarios, so no need to prepare anything in advance. A cognitive test is also part of the online assessment. Introductory call: During the week of September 28th to October 2nd , we may reach out for a short introductory call if we would like to clarify or learn a little more based on your application. This is a chance to get to know you better and hear more about your motivation for the program. Interviews: Upon completing the online assessments, we will be in touch to let you know if your application has been successful. You will then be invited for an interview in our office in Leiden. We’re aiming to hold these between October 6th and October 16th . Assessment Day: Then it’s time for the in-person Assessment Day, where you will participate in various activities and evaluations. This will take place on October 30th; physical presence is required. Upon successfully completing all stages, you will receive an offer to join HEINEKEN’s Global Graduate Program from March 1st, 2027 . Prior to each selection component, further information will be provided via email. If you have any questions, you can contact the Dutch Campus Recruitment team at [email protected]. Disclaimer You can complete the Online Assessment only once. If you apply to multiple GGP positions within the same country, you may receive several invitations, but the assessment is identical and accessible only a single time. Your result will be linked to the first position you applied for and visible only to recruiters for that specific role (e.g., GGP Finance, GGP Commerce). To avoid confusion and ensure your results align with your preference, we recommend applying to only one GGP position per country . We know AI is part of today’s world, and chances are, you might use it while preparing your application. That’s absolutely fine. Just remember, we’re genuinely curious about you. So feel free to use AI as a sparring partner, but make sure your application reflects your own ideas, personality and motivation. That’s what we value most and what helps you stand out.
